Looking for a music bar in Sapporo? FxxK Up is a rock bar in Susukino where rock, punk and metal set the tone. Some nights wander into dub, reggae, blues, or other musical explorations. It depends on the vibe, and song requests are welcome.

FOUR TASTES / ONE ROOM

The playlist shifts with the person behind the bar. Each of us brings a different set of ears, so the soundtrack can take a new turn from one night to the next.

Start with a favorite band, ask what’s playing, or put in a song request. The best part is seeing where the conversation goes.

01 / THE PUNK ROOTS

NORI

80s, 90s and 2000s punk, with reggae, blues and classic rock always in the mix.

02 / OFF THE MAP

CHUCK

Underground and avant-garde first. A serious allergy to popular music, with an appreciation for the classics.

03 / THE OPEN EARS

HARUKA

Indie rock, classic rock and new discoveries. There’s always room for something just around the corner.

04 / FULL WEIGHT

KANATA

Modern thrash, metal and generally anything heavy. More riffs, more volume, no apology.
